ambient_events: A trucker leans on their horn out of boredom and three others answer.
A card game folds abruptly as a dispatcher's voice barks a load number.
description: The haulers' street, lined with idling trucks and the cafes and card games that spring up wherever drivers wait. The engine-fug never lifts and the coffee is, somehow, worse than the fug.
name: Dray Street
